headline: Welcoming Mike McFaul and Larry Diamond to American Purpose
author: Francis Fukuyama

paragraphs.text: I’m very happy to announce that Mike McFaul and Larry Diamond have agreed to become regular columnists for American Purpose.

Mike is currently Ken Olivier and Angela Nomellini Professor of International Studies in the Department of Political Science at Stanford University, and a senior fellow at Stanford’s Freeman Spogli Institute (FSI) and Hoover Institution. He was also a former U.S. ambassador to Russia and NSC staff member.
Larry is Mosbacher Senior Fellow in Global Democracy, also at FSI, and Senior Fellow at the Hoover Institution. He is one of the world’s leading experts on global democracy.
We welcome Mike and Larry to the American Purpose family, and look forward to their future regular contributions.
Clear here to read Mike’s recent essay on America after the midterms.
Click here to read Larry’s recent essay on why America need democratic reform.
– Frank Fukuyama on behalf of American Purpose at Persuasion.
